blueprint.name: BNK 2.2 Platform (AWS)
blueprint.description: Deploys F5 BNK 2.2 on AWS EKS with optimized defaults — host-device CNI, gp3 storage, ENI secondary IP assignment. Battle-tested and production-ready. Requires jwt_token and cne_pull_secret.

outcomes: F5 Lifecycle Operator (FLO) managing all BNK components
TMM data-plane with full BNK component suite
Jetstack cert-manager installed with BNK-compatible TLS prerequisites
Multus NADs configured for raw L2 data-plane attachment (no NAD IPAM)
F5SPKVlan CRs with custom self-IPs and subnets
GatewayClass ready for Gateway API routing

prerequisites.description: Kubernetes cluster with HugePages, SR-IOV, and Multus CNI configured. Existing-cluster differences (device plugin labels/resource names, CA issuer policy, storage classes) must be aligned for your environment.
F5 license JWT token from MyF5 (injected into bnk/flo)
prerequisites.name: jwt_token

prerequisites.description: Base64-encoded F5 FAR service account key JSON content (injected into k8s/bnk-prerequisites). Falls back to encrypted System Default if not set in project.
prerequisites.name: cne_pull_secret

modules.name: BNK Prerequisites
modules.description: Creates namespaces (f5-operator, f5-utils, bnk-gw), FAR pull secrets

modules.name: Network Attachments
modules.description: Creates Multus NADs for TMM data-plane interfaces. Raw L2 NAD model only (no NAD IPAM). Set CNI type and SR-IOV resource names for your cluster.

modules.name: Cert Manager
modules.description: Installs Jetstack cert-manager for BNK TLS prerequisites only. Issuer/CA resources are managed by the dedicated Forge manifest module.

modules.name: BNK Cert Issuer
modules.description: Creates the Forge-managed cert-manager issuer chain (self-signed ClusterIssuer, BNK CA certificate/secret, and bnk-ca-cluster-issuer).

modules.name: F5 Lifecycle Operator
modules.description: Deploys FLO via Helm with CPCL key and license activation

modules.name: CNE Instance
modules.description: Creates CNEInstance CR — triggers FLO to deploy TMM and all BNK components

modules.name: BNK VLANs
modules.description: Creates F5SPKVlan CRs — sets TMM self-IPs on data-plane interfaces. Prefix lengths are configured directly; NAD CIDR/IPAM is not used in this flow.

modules.name: BNK GatewayClass
modules.description: Creates GatewayClass for BNK (controllerName auto-constructed from FLO namespace)
